english: She said maybe tomorrow.
She has been saying that for three weeks.
persian: سه هفته است که همین را می‌گوید.

english: I don't think tomorrow will come.
Her name is Lena. She is my neighbor.
She borrowed my blue book.
It is a small book about birds.
I don't read it often.
But I miss it.
Every evening I knock on her door.
persian: هر شب در خانه‌اش را می‌زنم.

english: She opens it and smiles.
persian: در را باز می‌کند و لبخند می‌زند.

english: She says: maybe tomorrow.
I say: okay.
But I don't know why I say okay.
One day I knocked and she was not home.
persian: یک روز در زدم و خانه نبود.

english: I sat on the stairs and waited.
persian: روی پله‌ها نشستم و منتظر ماندم.

english: An hour later she came back.
She was carrying my book.
She looked embarrassed.
She said: I kept it too long. I'm sorry.
persian: گفت: خیلی طولانی نگه داشتم. ببخشید.

english: I took the book. I was happy.
But also — I missed knocking on her door every evening.
persian: اما — دلم هم تنگ شد برای اینکه هر شب در خانه‌اش را بزنم.
